source_title: Man City 5-3 Sunderland: Eight-goal thriller at the Etihad
source_text: Manchester City beat Sunderland 5-3 at the Etihad. Enzo Fernández opened the scoring with a free kick in the 9th minute. Brian Brobbey equalised for Sunderland in the 12th. Rayan Cherki made it 2-1 in the 29th. Brobbey scored again in the 33rd. Antoine Semenyo scored in the 43rd to make it 3-2 at the break. Semenyo added his second in the 57th. Brobbey completed his hat-trick in the 59th. Erling Haaland closed the scoring in the 81st. The win takes City three points clear at the top of the Premier League.
